baseline_specification.name: Embedding-Aware Deterministic Baseline (B_det_emb)
baseline_specification.description: Unlearned deterministic baseline connecting continuous embeddings to discrete B_det via fixed codebook decoding, nearest-neighbor projection, and known invertible linear map inversion.

components.role: Applies W^-1 to project continuous distributed coordinates back to canonical embedding space.
Projects continuous vectors to discrete token vocabulary via Euclidean argmin over codebook C.
Executes public operation semantics (BindOp, NeighborMaxOp) using existing AST descriptors.

control_1_discrete_symbols.name: Discrete Symbols / One-Hot Identity Basis
control_1_discrete_symbols.scientific_interpretation: Trivially isomorphic to discrete B_det. Establishes zero degradation on symbolic identity basis.

control_2_invertible_distributed.name: Invertible Distributed Representation
control_2_invertible_distributed.scientific_interpretation: Continuous distributed embedding space does not hinder B_det_emb. W^-1 perfectly inverts representation.

control_3_equidistant_collision.name: Equidistant Collision / Voronoi Decision Boundary
control_3_equidistant_collision.scientific_interpretation: Midpoint embedding produces an exact tie. Information H(X|H(X)) > 0 is destroyed. Failure is an information-theoretic identifiability limit that no learner can overcome without oracle supervision.

control_4_lossy_projection.name: Information-Lossy Mapping / Non-Injective Projection
control_4_lossy_projection.scientific_interpretation: Rank-deficient map erases distinguishing dimensions between key tokens. Loss of identifiability is purely representation-level information erasure, not baseline insufficiency.

control_5_bounded_perturbation.name: Bounded Perturbation within Registered Margin
control_5_bounded_perturbation.scientific_interpretation: Nearest-neighbor projection remains 100% robust to perturbations strictly bounded within the Voronoi safety margin.

residual_hypothesis_specification.hypothesis_name: H-C1-Residual: Blind Continuous Manifold Grounding & Unsupervised Codebook Discovery
residual_hypothesis_specification.formal_definition: When content representations h(x) reside on an unknown continuous manifold without an explicit codebook C or known inverse map W^-1, can a continuous neural attention mechanism discover the discrete token equivalence classes and execute relational routing under token loss supervision alone?
conditions_for_residual_validity: Codebook C must be strictly hidden / unknown to the router a priori.
The manifold transformation must be non-linear or uncalibrated.
No direct coordinate or token supervision is provided during discovery.

baseline_delta_definition.interpretation: B_det_emb equipped with oracle codebook C establishes the upper bound ceiling (1.000). Any gap Delta < 0 in a neural model represents sample complexity or manifold discovery deficit.
